column4: A single inventory item icon for a 1990s first-person PC game, pixel art drawn large with crisp square pixels: EXACTLY the black handheld walkie-talkie of the reference image (same chunky black plastic body, same short stubby antenna on top, same small speaker grille and the little red light), but alone, with no hand and no glove, standing upright, seen straight from the front, centred, filling 80 percent of the height of the picture. Dark outline, strong simple shading, low saturation, the same palette as the reference. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no shadow, no text, no border.
